alignments.note: Explicit subject pronoun 'I'; the copula goes to the predicate under rule 20.

Comparative kə standing on the construct noun pî, rendered by the single expression 'even as ... art'. No English word here is spent on peh's own lexeme, so no morpheme owns a part of the rendering and rule 30's one-rendering condition is met; the clause's supplied copula joins the whole expression under rule 20 and does not defeat that condition. Headed on the construct noun under rule 23, exactly as lə + pānay -> 'before' is headed in JOB.33.5. Discontinuous around the suffix's 'thou' under rule 25. Competing reading: give the whole expression to the preposition and mark pî unrepresented, which is what this verse formerly did; rejected because it leaves a lexical noun with no English beside a preposition holding the whole word, against rules 30 and 22, and because it would split the chapter's treatment of this construction. The margin's 'I am according to thy wish in God's stead' was read and set aside under rule 38.
2ms suffix rendered by the pronoun 'thou' (rule 18); the suffix is no part of the fused compound preposition, exactly as the 1cs suffix keeps its own 'me' in JOB.33.5.

Preposition rendered 'toward'; the clause's supplied copula joins the preposition heading the phrase the ASV predicates (rule 49). Competing reading: give 'am' to the comparative predicate instead, but the ASV already writes a separate 'art' there.
Article assimilated into the pointed preposition; the ASV writes no 'the' before 'God' (rules 12 and 29).
min rendered 'out of', headed on the token carrying the ablative lexeme (rule 24).
'the clay' with a supplied determiner joining the noun (rule 15).
Pual perfect 'am formed', headed on the lexical verb.

review_notes: kə + pî is fused as one noncompositional unit headed on the construct noun, bringing this verse into line with JOB.33.5's lə + pānay -> 'before'; the competing reading, which the verse formerly took, is named in that unit's note.
The ASV's marginal alternative for the first colon was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
